_comment: What sanoMIT forked, from where, and under what licence. tools/check-provenance.sh verifies it. The forked files are byte-identical to upstream on purpose: the fork is the audit trail.

not_forked._comment: Deliberately NOT taken from vendor/sanoTTS, and why. Anything there that touches espeak-ng, misaki or piper is GPL-3.0.
not_forked.mcu/ports/wasm/espeak/**: espeak-ng itself: GPL-3.0, and the thing this fork exists to avoid
not_forked.mcu/ports/wasm/snt_nano_wasm.c: not in the MIT file list; sanoMIT's wasm face is runtime/ports/wasm/smit_wasm.c
not_forked.mcu/ports/wasm/snt_port_wasm.c: not in the MIT file list; sanoMIT's port is runtime/ports/wasm/smit_port_wasm.c
not_forked.mcu/src/snt_front_*.c, snt_piperlite*.c,: not in the MIT file list, so GPL-3.0; the nano line does not need them
not_forked.mcu/test/**: test fixtures including espeak-derived id goldens: GPL-3.0. sanoMIT's baseline was recorded from its own runtime instead
not_forked.web/**, pypkg/**, npmpkg/**: the GPL packaging and front ends

data_not_committed.g2p/data/g2p_model.json: g2p_en neural G2P weights via tiny-tts (Apache-2.0)
data_not_committed.voices/heartnano/*.bin: the voice weights: upstream voice DATA with its own licence, see voices/README.md
